attention_compatibility.status: numerically verified for isolated attention operation
attention_compatibility.details: Raw scaled-dot-product GQA with 15 query heads, 5 KV heads, head_dim 64, 3:1 mapping, and merged 960-feature output passed an independent expanded-KV reference.

rope_compatibility.status: not directly compatible; not integrated or weight-tested
rope_compatibility.target: Repository integration evidence describes SmolLM2/Llama split-half RoPE with rope_theta=100000 and no RoPE scaling.
rope_compatibility.zeta_existing: rotary_embedding uses interleaved even/odd rotation and defaults to base=10000.
rope_compatibility.required_work: Preserve native split-half convention and exact target base/position handling in a separate adapter; do not apply the current Zeta RoPE to pretrained projections.

kv_cache_compatibility.status: partial structural compatibility; no direct integration validation
kv_cache_compatibility.compatible_contiguous_case: The attention API accepts [batch, 5, key_length, 64]; StreamingKVCache can structurally store [batch, 5, 1, 64] one-token appends. Full contiguous cached keys with end-aligned queries are shape-compatible.
incompatible_unverified_cases: No absolute key/query positions are accepted by GroupedQueryAttention.
A sink/recent cache with discontiguous retained positions cannot use the API's inferred end-aligned causal mask correctly without an explicit absolute-position mask or adapter.
StreamingKVCache is detached/inference-only, appends one position at a time, and has no per-row position or beam-reordering interface.
The new attention API and cache have not been integration-tested together.

tensor_layout_and_checkpoint_mapping.mapping_status: Expected projected-channel reshape/flatten contract documented; actual checkpoint weights and keys were not loaded or validated.
